title: Email/get: fetch_smtp_emails_batch silently swallows DB errors via unwrap_or_default
description: email/get.rs fetch_smtp_emails_batch() calls .fetch_all().await.unwrap_or_default(). A DB error (connection loss, schema change) returns an empty HashMap, causing all smtp: IDs in the request to appear as notFound to the client with no error reported and no log. Fix: propagate the error to the caller, which should log it and return a serverFail or partial result.
